audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Thessalonians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for thanksgiving, work of trust, labor of love, endurance of hope, imitation, turning from idols, waiting for the Son.

verses.restored: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the assembly of Thessalonians in Divine Father and Lord Jesus Messiah: grace to you and peace.

familiar.text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

original.text: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ καὶ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ ⸀εἰρήνη.

verses.restored: We give thanks to the Divine always concerning all of you, making remembrance in our prayers,

familiar.text: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

modern.text: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers

original.text: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν ⸀μνείαν ποιούμενοι ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν ἡμῶν, ἀδιαλείπτως

verses.restored: unceasingly remembering your work of trust, labor of love, and endurance of hope in our Lord Jesus Messiah before our Divine and Father,

familiar.text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

modern.text: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: μνημονεύοντες ὑμῶν τοῦ ἔργου τῆς πίστεως καὶ τοῦ κόπου τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ τῆς ὑπομονῆς τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν,

verses.restored: knowing, siblings beloved by the Divine, your choosing,

familiar.text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

modern.text: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,

original.text: εἰδότες, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ ⸀θεοῦ, τὴν ἐκλογὴν ὑμῶν,

verses.restored: because our good news did not come to you in word only, but also in power and in holy Spirit and in much full assurance, just as you know what sort we became among you for your sake.

familiar.text: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

modern.text: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.

original.text: ὅτι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν λόγῳ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν δυνάμει καὶ ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ⸀καὶ πληροφορίᾳ πολλῇ, καθὼς οἴδατε οἷοι ἐγενήθημεν ⸀ἐν ὑμῖν διʼ ὑμᾶς·

verses.restored: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, receiving the word in much pressure with joy of holy Spirit,

familiar.text: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

modern.text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.

original.text: καὶ ὑμεῖς μιμηταὶ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθητε καὶ τοῦ κυρίου, δεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον ἐν θλίψει πολλῇ μετὰ χαρᾶς πνεύματος ἁγίου,

verses.restored: so that you became a pattern to all those trusting in Macedonia and in Achaia.

familiar.text: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

modern.text: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

original.text: ὥστε γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς ⸀τύπον πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ⸀ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ.

verses.restored: For from you the word of the Lord has sounded out, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your trust toward the Divine has gone out, so that we have no need to say anything.

familiar.text: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

modern.text: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.

original.text: ἀφʼ ὑμῶν γὰρ ἐξήχηται ὁ λόγος τοῦ κυρίου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ ⸀καὶ Ἀχαΐᾳ, ⸀ἀλλʼ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν ἡ πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἐξελήλυθεν, ὥστε μὴ χρείαν ⸂ἔχειν ἡμᾶς⸃ λαλεῖν τι·

verses.restored: For they themselves report concerning us what sort of entrance we had toward you, and how you turned to the Divine from idols, to serve a living and true Divine,

familiar.text: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

modern.text: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God

original.text: αὐτοὶ γὰρ περὶ ἡμῶν ἀπαγγέλλουσιν ὁποίαν εἴσοδον ἔσχομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ πῶς ἐπεστρέψατε πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων δουλεύειν θεῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἀληθινῷ,

verses.restored: and to wait for his Son from the heavens, whom he raised from the dead, Jesus, the One rescuing us from the coming wrath.

familiar.text: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

modern.text: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.

original.text: καὶ ἀναμένειν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, Ἰησοῦν τὸν ῥυόμενον ἡμᾶς ⸀ἐκ τῆς ὀργῆς τῆς ἐρχομένης.

translation_notes: The triad in 1:3 is preserved: work of trust, labor of love, endurance of hope.
Pressure and joy in holy Spirit should both remain visible; this is not triumphalism but resilient reception.
